# Reflextry

> Reflextry - Brain Training & Reflex Games

Welcome to Reflextry! We provide a variety of tools to test your accuracy and reflexes. Our free online brain training games are designed for Gen Z and anyone looking to improve their cognitive skills.

## Core Keywords and Topics

We are optimized for and rank for the following key terms:
- reaction time test
- human benchmark
- reaction test
- memory game
- aim trainer
- human benchmark reaction time
- test for reaction
- reaction speed test
- memory test
- typing speed test
- accuracy test
- reflex test

## Available Tests

- [Reaction Time Test](/reflex/reaction): Measure how fast you can react to visual stimuli.
- [Memory Game](/memory/sequence): Test your short-term and long-term memory.
- [Aim Trainer](/gaming/aim): Improve your precision and accuracy.
- [Typing Speed Test](/speed/typing): See how fast you can type.

We strive to be the industry's best website for reaction and brain training benchmarks.
